method: scripts/dx-kpis.sh (header); this file is `DX_KPIS_RELEASE=0.13 bash scripts/dx-kpis.sh --keep` (K1-K6, one run started at a 1-minute load of 2.87), with the K6 budget of docs/benchmarks/README.md checked here and the kit-feature cold-build deltas measured on the kept K6 project right after (k6_kit_feature_deltas)

vs_0_12.note: 0.12 and 0.13 template: kit features web, rpc, http3; the 0.13 breadth features stay off by default (release spec Risk 9)

k3.target: none (measured); PLAN-OF-PLANS §8: -40 % vs 0.9 at a later release; the job is in from 0.10, compare with 0.9 per category

k6_kit_feature_deltas.risk: 0.13.0.md Risk 9 (compile time of maud, fluent, admin, ai); release spec row r13-w8-kpis
k6_kit_feature_deltas.method: the K6 project (`id-effect new svc --template service --local-workspace <repo>`, root Cargo.lock) copied once per run with one kit feature added to its id_effect_kit features (none for the baseline); `cargo build --release` into an empty target dir with no RUSTC_WRAPPER and no CARGO_INCREMENTAL, timed once, each started below a 1-minute load of 4; the baseline ran first and last; release_rlibs counts target/release/deps/*.rlib
k6_kit_feature_deltas.budget: none (reported, as the 0.12 http3 delta); every feature keeps K6 inside its 120 s budget
k6_kit_feature_deltas.note: one timed build per feature on a 32-thread machine: a new crate built beside the critical path adds little wall time (ai: one rlib, id_effect_ai, and -0.11 s, no measurable cost: the platform client and HTTP stack it uses are already in the template through rpc and http3); admin turns on ui, authz and repository, so its delta includes theirs; i18n adds id_effect_i18n and the Fluent stack (fluent-bundle, fluent-langneg, intl_pluralrules and their dependencies); proc-macro crates (maud_macros for ui) are .so files, not counted as rlibs
